title: Idempotent producer decision
summary: Classifies an incoming batch against a producer's tracked entry and the sequence ranges of the batches it retains, Kafka's UnifiedLog.analyzeAndValidateProducerState for a client append. At the entry's epoch, a batch whose base sequence and last sequence (base_sequence + last_offset_delta modulo 2^31) equal a retained batch's is a duplicate of the first such batch, and a null slot never matches. Only a batch that repeats no retained batch goes on to the sequence check: a producer with no entry can start at any sequence (under Kafka trunk rules an empty log requires sequence 0; this page runs Kafka 4.3.1 rules, log_empty = false and trunk_rules = false); a lower epoch is fenced; a higher epoch must start at sequence 0 and is otherwise out of order; the same epoch must continue at the last sequence plus one modulo 2^31 and is otherwise out of order.
signature: pub fn producer_decision(entry: Option<ProducerEntryFacts>, retained: &[Option<RetainedSequenceRange>], producer_epoch: i16, base_sequence: i32, last_offset_delta: i32, log_empty: bool, trunk_rules: bool) -> ProducerDecision

retained_matches(slot, base_sequence, last_offset_delta) = match slot { Some(range) => range.base_sequence@ == base_sequence@ && range.last_sequence@ == sequence_modulo_2_31(base_sequence@ + last_offset_delta@), None => false }

retained_duplicate_exists(entry, retained, producer_epoch, base_sequence, last_offset_delta) = match entry { Some(tracked) => tracked.epoch@ == producer_epoch@ && exists<i: Int> 0 <= i && i < retained.len() && retained_matches(retained[i], base_sequence, last_offset_delta), None => false }

first_retained_duplicate(entry, retained, producer_epoch, base_sequence, last_offset_delta, index) = match entry { Some(tracked) => tracked.epoch@ == producer_epoch@ && 0 <= index && index < retained.len() && retained_matches(retained[index], base_sequence, last_offset_delta) && forall<j: Int> 0 <= j && j < index ==> !retained_matches(retained[j], base_sequence, last_offset_delta), None => false }

sequence_decision(entry, producer_epoch, base_sequence, log_empty, trunk_rules) = match entry { None => if trunk_rules && log_empty && base_sequence@ != 0 { ProducerDecision::OutOfOrder } else { ProducerDecision::Append }, Some(tracked) => if producer_epoch@ < tracked.epoch@ { ProducerDecision::Fenced } else if producer_epoch@ > tracked.epoch@ { if base_sequence@ == 0 { ProducerDecision::Append } else { ProducerDecision::OutOfOrder } } else if base_sequence@ == sequence_modulo_2_31(tracked.last_sequence@ + 1) { ProducerDecision::Append } else { ProducerDecision::OutOfOrder } }
sequence_modulo_2_31(sequence) = sequence.rem_euclid(2147483648)

title: Vote admission
summary: Classifies exact recipient and membership admission for a KIP-595 Vote request, shared by binding votes and pre-votes before the epoch and log checks. The target alone decides IgnoreWrongTarget: a Vote addressed to another voter or directory is ignored without a reply. For the exact target, the memberships decide between Deny and Consider: the request is denied unless the cluster matches and both the local node and the candidate are voters.
signature: pub fn vote_admission_decision(target: VoteTarget, membership: VoteMembership) -> VoteAdmissionDecision
ensures: (result == VoteAdmissionDecision::IgnoreWrongTarget) == (target.voter_id@ != target.local_id@ || !target.directory_matches)

(result == VoteAdmissionDecision::Deny) == ( target.voter_id@ == target.local_id@ && target.directory_matches && (!membership.cluster_matches || !membership.local_is_voter || !membership.candidate_is_voter) )

(result == VoteAdmissionDecision::Consider) == ( target.voter_id@ == target.local_id@ && target.directory_matches && membership.cluster_matches && membership.local_is_voter && membership.candidate_is_voter )
